# CometAPI

> Unified API platform providing access to 500+ AI models including GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, image generation, and video models with enterprise-grade security.

CometAPI simplifies AI integration by offering a single API endpoint for leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Black Forest Labs, and more. The platform serves both developers and enterprises with SOC 2 compliance, flexible pricing, and multi-modal capabilities spanning text, image, and video generation.

## Key Topics

- Unified API access
- GPT-5 and OpenAI models
- Claude (Anthropic)
- Google Gemini and Nano Banana Pro
- Grok 4.20 Beta
- Image generation (FLUX, Midjourney)
- Text-to-video models
- Enterprise AI platform
- API integration
- Cost optimization
- SOC 2 compliance
- Multi-model access
- Agentic AI
- Coding models
- Generative AI
